title: The scripts under Server and Servex: what each is, who calls it, which are stale

chat.text: About a hundred scripts sit under Server and Servex with no census. A script lists each one with its header line, its callers, its last commit and whether it is a class; Haiku gives a verdict (live, hand-run tool, stale, misnamed) with evidence; you get a tick-list of the stale ones, a mover with undo that is not run, and the misnamed ones go to the todo list.

message.text:
task-mastermind-scripts-census: The scripts census is done and committed (`66b6b048e`). The full table is at [Server/doc/scripts.md](/Server/doc/scripts.md). Of the 193 scripts, 1 is stale and 26 are misnamed. I did not merge to `michael/dev`.

- **Counts:** the census script (`Server/ScriptsCensus.mjs`) lists 193 files, and a separate `ls` count also gives 193. By verdict: 112 live, 54 tool, 1 stale, 26 misnamed.
- **Only one stale script:** `Server/session-cost.mjs`, a 198-byte shim that points to its replacement. The repo is young, so most unreferenced files were touched within 30 days and I kept them.
- **Spot-check:** I
